ClausIE is able (1) to detect a large number of useful clauses in a sentence and to extract their arguments, and (2) to do this with high precision.

(i) the use of linguistic knowledge about the English language enables the detection of useful information expressed in sentences and (ii) the use of a clause-based approach allows for the extraction of high-precision extrusions.
(1) ClausIE is the first approach that is able to generate extractions that are both highly precise and highly accurate.

a fundamental aspect of open information extraction, the extraction process.

the following questions: How can we exploit linguistic knowledge about the English language to detect clauses and their types in natural language text? How can we exploit the type information about clauses to extract high-quality relations and their arguments in a clause-based approach to information extraction?
the following question: What are the most effective techniques to extract relations and their arguments in a robust and scalable manner from natural language text?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ClausIE is the most promising open information extraction system to date.
ClausIE is a state of the art open information extraction system that is competitive with the best systems in terms of precision and recall.
our approach is the best one for the moment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ClausIE extracts more high quality relations from text than previous systems.

ClausIE is able (a) to extract a larger set of relations than existing open information extraction tools; (b) to generate extractions with a high precision and recall; (c) to operate on noisy data without any training; and (d) to generate extrac- tions in a clause-based representation, which is more flexible than existing extractions.
ClausIE achieves state of the art in both precision and recall.
The main takeaway from our work is that
clause detection is a powerful and robust technique to identify ``useful'' information expressed in text.
clause-based extraction can provide a more principled and more accurate alternative to the existing approaches to open information extraction.
clause-based open information is an effective approach for open IE, and that it is able to obtain high-quality extractions from noisy text.
